officialLinks.label: Grades, grade points, GPA formula and truncation

helpIntro: Baylor uses a 4.0 scale with plus/minus grades. Enter Baylor semester hours and final grades to estimate your current or projected undergraduate GPA.
helpNote: Baylor truncates the official GPA after two decimal places rather than rounding. Repeat Impact is disabled because ordinary repeats count all Baylor grades unless undergraduate Academic Forgiveness has actually been approved.
helpExample: A 3-hour A earns 12.00 grade points; a 3-hour B- earns 8.01. Together, 20.01 ÷ 6 = 3.335, while Baylor’s official method truncates to 3.33.

gradeExplanations.A: A = 4.00 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.A-: A- = 3.67 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.B+: B+ = 3.33 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.B: B = 3.00 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.B-: B- = 2.67 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.C+: C+ = 2.33 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.C: C = 2.00 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.C-: C- = 1.67 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.D+: D+ = 1.33 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.D: D = 1.00 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.D-: D- = 0.67 grade points per semester hour.
gradeExplanations.F: Fail; zero grade points and GPA-bearing hours count.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete; excluded until replaced by a final grade.
gradeExplanations.P: Pass; credit may be earned but the grade is excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.FA: Fail under Pass/Fail; excluded from GPA.

repeatPolicy.note: Repeat Impact is disabled. Enter all counted attempts. If Baylor has already approved Academic Forgiveness, omit the transcript grade marked excluded (E); otherwise include every Baylor grade.
